response.overview: FOSTA, slang for “forcing things to happen,” is an intimate portrait of Thulani ‘Fosta’ Headman, who returns to his community after prison, determined to rewrite his story. Rooted in a lineage of unfulfilled dreams, he finds renewed purpose mentoring Siphe Fassie, nephew of South African music icon Brenda Fassie, and working with Spanish entrepreneur Valentino Barrioseta. Together, they build a music academy in Langa, Cape Town, creating lasting opportunities where once there was only fleeting inspiration. Filmed over more than a decade, FOSTA explores music as a force for reinvention, mentorship and community-led change. From the streets of Langa to the stages of Glastonbury, Ibiza and Amsterdam, the film explores mentorship, memory, and redemption. A story of reckoning, survival, and the healing power of sound.
response.tagline: He wanted music to change his life… It ended up changing theirs
response.title: Fosta

release_dates.note: Official Selection Durban International Film Festival
